faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 1 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: A family's rental home in Missouri turns into a nightmare filled with terrifying screams.
kurzfassung: In 2001, single father Steven LaChance moved his family into a spacious house in Union, Missouri, unaware of the intense haunting awaiting them. The family experienced extreme paranormal activity, including temperature drops, shadowy figures, and agonizing screams echoing through the home. Subsequent tenants faced similarly horrific encounters before the property's dark history of violence came to light.
stichpunkte: Steven LaChance and his three children moved into an affordable rental house on North Christina Avenue in Union, Missouri, in 2001.
Early signs of trouble included interior doors with outside latches, falling picture frames, and locals visibly avoiding walking past the property.
The children experienced severe disturbances, including a basement encounter, a hallway apparition resembling a clown, and a dark shadowy figure in the kitchen.
The house frequently dropped in temperature and was plagued by violent shaking and the loud, painful screams of a man and a child.
After fleeing the property, Steven contacted previous tenants and learned that others had abruptly abandoned the house due to strange occurrences.
A subsequent family, the Marshes, moved in and endured similar terror, including teenage daughter Ashley seeing an apparition of an infant and suffering severe psychological distress.
Paranormal investigators and a local priest visited the property, confirming heavy spirit activity linked to the site's violent history dating back to the Civil War.
Linda Marsh was physically attacked by an unseen force in her bedroom, leading to hospitalization before both families permanently abandoned the haunted house.

clips.hook: Latches on the outside of doors
clips.text: While unpacking boxes, the father notices that all interior doors feature hook and eye latches positioned specifically on the outer side.
The indoor temperature suddenly plummets to nearly thirty degrees lower than the weather outside, accompanied by a chilling physical sensation.
As the family is being ushered out of the front door, a loud and agonizing cry of a man echoes from within the empty house.

clips.hook: A horrifying sight in the backyard
clips.text: The teenage daughter discovers the upside-down body of an infant hanging by a rope from a tree branch in broad daylight.

clips.hook: A man of the cloth refuses to enter
clips.text: When attempting to bless the home, the local priest abruptly stops and refuses to go upstairs because the energy is too overwhelming.

beschreibung:
In the spring of 2001, single father Steven LaChance moved his family from a cramped apartment to a spacious house in Union, Missouri. The house was intended to be a new start for the family, but before long their excitement turned to dread as life in the new house became a nightmare.
Within weeks of moving into the house, Steven and his children began experiencing strange and unexplainable phenomena. Lights turned on and off by themselves, temperatures fluctuated wildly from room to room, and there was an ever-present feeling of being watched. In time, whatever entity lived in the house began focusing its malevolent attention on the children, exploiting their fears and terrifying them night after night. After several months, the LaChance family couldn’t tolerate the home anymore and moved out but, little did Steven know, that was only the beginning of his journey into the paranormal.
